evidence: User-pasted Unity summary.json; trained checkpoint and sampled arrays remain on Unity and have not been independently rescored locally
evaluation_task: Known-graph coordinate generation; reference atoms, counts and graph supplied; not IR-only identification

raw.rmsd_metric: Fixed atom correspondence, proper rotation, heavy atoms, angstroms; no chemical identity gate

chemistry.identity_gate: RDKit-perceived connected graph plus isomeric SMILES equality after stereochemistry assignment from generated/reference 3D geometry

limitations: Validation subset with the correct graph supplied; not end-to-end IR-to-3D accuracy.
Best-of-five uses the reference to identify a successful sample; there is no deployable ranking rule.
The strict chemistry identity gate includes geometry-assigned stereochemistry; a mismatch cannot be attributed to connectivity alone.
Sanitized connected structures do not establish energy stability or IR spectral agreement.
No matched graph-only baseline, spectral ablation, MMFF refinement comparison or full test-set result has been supplied yet.
